title: Testing a Personalized Approach to Chronic Low Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial in Older Veterans
comparison_or_design: The primary Personalized Aging Back Clinics comparison.
excluded: Months 3/9/12, mental-health and other PROMIS domains
Pain, falls, life space, utilization and exploratory/sensitivity analyses
population_or_material: The intention-to-treat cohort of older veterans with chronic low back pain.
requested_items: Baseline arm means, six-month arm changes and main adjusted mixed-model contrasts for ODI/PROMIS physical function/global physical health. Use exact model-specific secondary comparisons, not generic significance statements. Exclude other visits and healthcare-utilization endpoints.
